statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of recurrent palpitations and intermittent episodes of syncope
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is medically necessary for comprehensive evaluation
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and R55
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
